calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, min(d.calendar_date) AS mind, max(d.calendar_date) AS maxd, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900),
ctl AS (SELECT s.format, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_gross, sum(r.receipts) AS ctl_receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=r.store_id AND s.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.format, count(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS rec_ids, count(DISTINCT (l.receipt_id,l.store_id)) AS rec_store, sum(l.net_amount) AS all_net, sum(CASE WHEN l.category='ZZ Test' THEN l.net_amount END) AS test_net, sum(CASE WHEN l.staff_purchase_flag THEN l.net_amount END) AS staff_net, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.staff_purchase_flag THEN l.receipt_id END) AS staff_rec, any_value(ctl.ctl_gross) AS ctl_gross, any_value(ctl.ctl_receipts) AS ctl_receipts,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.quantity<=0 OR l.net_amount<=0) AS nonpos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.channel_code='WB') AS wb
FROM l LEFT JOIN ctl ON ctl.format=l.format GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT store_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT format) AS formats, string_agg(DISTINCT format, ',') AS fmts, min(open_date) o, max(close_date) c
FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1 OR max(close_date) IS NOT NULL OR min(open_date) IS NOT NULL

calls.statement:
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, s.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format
